verdict: Lead volume collapsed this week; budget cuts are the confirmed cause.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 17 leads at an average cost of $98.61 per lead, but the last 7 days tell a sharper story: only 1 lead came in as Google Ads spend was cut 43% and recorded $0 in spend on multiple days — the lead drought follows that pullback directly. Meta delivered all 17 of the 28-day leads at an efficient $38 per lead, but has also gone quiet in the most recent 7-day window. Google Ads spend is being restored and heating-season campaigns are being brought live now to rebuild volume heading into the peak demand period. You should expect lead counts to recover as spend is reinstated, though the first days of renewed activity will need close monitoring before the trend firms up.
